q1.question: How does SeaVoice differ from a traditional Chatbot?
q1.answer: SeaVoice provides Real-time Suara Percakapan dengan Lanjutan AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, dan Berikan human-like responses over the phone. Unlike Teks-based chatbots, SeaVoice handles actual Panggilan Suara dengan natural speech patterns.

q2.answer: Pengaturan typically takes less than 20 minutes. You can Latih your Suara agent, Hubungkan your phone system, set up Panggilan rules, dan go live di one session.

q5.question: How does Harga work?

q9.question: Can SeaVoice handle emergency calls?
q9.answer: While SeaVoice can handle urgent inquiries dan escalate appropriately, we recommend maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaVoice can be configured ke immediately transfer emergency-related calls to human operators.

q10.question: Can SeaVoice detect spam calls?
